Out of curiosity @filipesilva - is it this line that squashes the fixup commits upon PR merge?

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/scripts/github/merge-pr#L198
Good stuff! :smiley: And I agree on that this particular documentation should be added to the contribution guidelines
@gkalpak I was trying to find this info in the guidelines, however, it's not there yet. A google search brought me here. Can we get this merged or can I help with any changes to it?

Thx for stepping up, @sonukapoor! My branch is still a WIP (so not merge-ready), but at this point I think it would be faster for me to finish it (than hand it over to someone else). I'll try to get it finished later this week.

issue.body:
Using fixup commits when addressing review feedback can considerably improve the review experience on subsequent reviews.

This commit adds information and guidelines for contributors on how to work with fixup commits.

Fixes #33042.
